videos.title: How does an Arduino read a button?
videos.subtitle: Engineering 201 · Pull-up resistor circuit
videos.description: A 50-second animated walkthrough of how a 10 kΩ pull-up resistor gives an Arduino input a reference voltage: why released reads HIGH, pressed reads LOW, and why a floating pin picks up noise.
